suggestions.title: g-rule-6 plan-file list still names implementation_plan.md, which this project archived
suggestions.rationale: g-rule-6 (Plan Adherence & Deviation Approval) names the project's designated plan file as '(implementation_plan.md, SPEC.md, or TASKS.md)' in both its BOOT DIGEST one-liner and its full Tier-2 text. In SuperMarioGame, implementation_plan.md's content was silently repurposed to an unrelated Standalone Enemy Behavior Test Suite design doc — it no longer held architecture diagrams or user answers, the very thing every citation of it still claimed. It was archived to docs/archive/2026-09-02_implementation_plan.md on 2026-09-02 (user-confirmed, submission_sweep_plan_2026-09-02.md §5.1/§7 Q1) and AGENTS.md's project-owned Key Files pointer and structure tree were repointed at SPEC.md. g-rule-6 itself is an AgentHub-owned Layer 3 rule inside the generated <!-- AGENTHUB:L3:BEGIN/END --> block (lines 396-612) and must not be hand-edited in this project (g-rule-18) - a local edit would silently revert on the next AgentHub sync and AGENTS.md would go back to citing an archived file with nothing failing. Recommend amending the upstream rule text to drop the file-specific example (a per-project fact that can and did drift) or to read generically, e.g. 'the project's designated plan file (see this project's Key Files pointer)'. If an example must stay inline, use SPEC.md/TASKS.md, phrased as '(SPEC.md or TASKS.md)' without the comma-before-or artifact left by deleting the first list item.
suggestions.evidence: AGENTS.md lines 408 and 497 (dev@6af4f8e) both read '...designated plan file (implementation_plan.md, SPEC.md, or TASKS.md) is the source of...'; docs/archive/2026-09-02_implementation_plan.md is the archived file, docs/archive/README.md documents the repurposing; SuperMarioGame/AGENTS.md line 20 (Key Files) now points at SPEC.md instead.
suggestions.deferRationale: Amending upstream Layer 3 rule text is a human/AgentHub-maintainer decision (g-rule-18); this lane only has write access to this project's repo, not ~/Documents/AgentHub, and is not authorized to promote its own suggestion.
